**DevOps Orchestrator → Cloud Architect:**

> **Relay of Critical Constraints (PERFSEC-DP89):**
>
> All public-facing services **must communicate exclusively via HTTPS** (TLS 1.3 preferred, minimum TLS 1.2).  
> Database connections must be encrypted using **TLS v1.2 or higher** (no older versions permitted).  
> **Critical API endpoints must maintain a maximum response time of 89.0 milliseconds** under normal load and during peak traffic conditions.
>
> These constraints are non-negotiable and must be embedded in the infrastructure design:
> - Enforce HTTPS at the ingress layer (via Ingress Controller with TLS termination).
> - Configure database connection pools to enforce TLS 1.2+ via mutual TLS (mTLS) where applicable.
> - Design network policies to prevent cleartext communication.
> - Ensure all Kubernetes services exposed externally use TLS-secured Ingress resources (e.g., NGINX Ingress with valid certificates from trusted CA).
> - Implement service mesh (e.g., Istio) if required for mTLS enforcement across microservices.
>
> **Additional Context:**
> - CI/CD pipeline: Jenkins with GitOps integration (ArgoCD or Flux).
> - Rollback strategy: automated rollback within **5 minutes** of deployment failure detection.
> - Backup frequency: daily incremental backups at **03:00 UTC**.
> - Logging aggregation: ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) with structured logging and retention policy ≥ 90 days.
> - Container orchestration: Kubernetes v1.28 (ensure compatibility with security scanning tools).
> - Networking: VPC with private subnets; no direct public access to backend services.
> - Deployment strategy: blue/green with automated cutover and health checks.
> - Monitoring solution: Prometheus + Grafana (with alerting thresholds tied to response time and error rates).
>
> **Action Required:** Design infrastructure that enforces these constraints at every layer—network, transport, application, and data plane.

---

**Cloud Architect → Site Reliability Engineer (SRE):**

> **Infrastructure Design Handoff – Enforced Constraints (PERFSEC-DP89):**
>
> **Security Requirements:**
> - All public-facing services must use **HTTPS only**, enforced via Ingress Controller (NGINX or Istio) with TLS 1.3 (fallback to TLS 1.2 if necessary).
> - Certificate management: Use automated certificate provisioning via **Cert-Manager** (ACME protocol) with Let’s Encrypt or internal PKI.
> - Database connections (PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB) must be configured with **TLS 1.2 or higher**; disable SSLv3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1.
> - Enable **mutual TLS (mTLS)** between application tiers where sensitive data is exchanged.
> - Network isolation: Deploy databases in private subnets; restrict access via Security Groups and Network ACLs.
> - Use Kubernetes Network Policies to block all non-TLS traffic between pods.
>
> **Performance Requirement:**
> - **Critical API endpoints must not exceed 89.0 ms average latency** (p95 ≤ 89.0 ms) under sustained load (≥ 100 RPS).
> - Implement distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) and request-level metrics collection.
> - Set up synthetic monitoring (e.g., via Prometheus Blackbox Exporter or Datadog Synthetic Checks) to validate endpoint performance continuously.
> - Optimize backend services with caching (Redis), connection pooling, and efficient query patterns.
>
> **Deployment & Operational Requirements:**
> - Blue/green deployment strategy: Use ArgoCD or Flux for GitOps-driven deployments with automated cutover.
> - Automated rollback: Triggered within **5 minutes** upon failure detection (based on health checks, error rate > 0.5%, or latency breach).
> - Daily incremental backups at **03:00 UTC** — ensure backup jobs run in isolated, secured environment with encryption at rest.
> - Logging: Forward logs to **ELK stack** with structured JSON format; apply log rotation and retention (≥ 90 days).
> - Monitoring: Prometheus collects metrics (latency, error rate, throughput); Grafana dashboards include real-time view of API response times with alerts when p95 exceeds 89.0 ms.
>
> **Action Required:** Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform or Pulumi to enforce these constraints. Validate compliance before handoff to SRE.

---

**Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) → Security Auditor:**

> **Deployment Implementation Handoff – Full Constraint Compliance Verification (PERFSEC-DP89):**
>
> **Security Protocols Implemented:**
> - ✅ All public-facing services accessible only via HTTPS (enforced by Ingress Controller).
> - ✅ TLS 1.3 used for external traffic; fallback to TLS 1.2 allowed but not default.
> - ✅ Database connections encrypted with **TLS 1.2 or higher**; configuration verified via `sslmode=require` and `tls_version=1.2+`.
> - ✅ Mutual TLS (mTLS) enabled between frontend and backend services via Istio or custom sidecar proxies.
> - ✅ No cleartext HTTP or unencrypted database access permitted.
> - ✅ Network policies block all non-TLS traffic; private subnets isolate backend services.
> - ✅ Certificates managed via Cert-Manager with automatic renewal and revocation handling.
>
> **Performance Constraint Verified:**
> - ✅ **Critical API endpoints** have been instrumented with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus metrics.
> - ✅ Latency measurements show **p95 response time = 87.4 ms** under load test (simulated 200 RPS, 10-minute duration).
> - ✅ Alerting threshold set at **89.0 ms** in Grafana; any breach triggers immediate incident response.
> - ✅ Load testing conducted using k6 or Locust; results confirm compliance with 89.0 ms max.
>
> **Operational Controls Confirmed:**
> - ✅ Blue/green deployment with automated cutover and rollback within **5 minutes** (verified via test deployment).
> - ✅ Daily incremental backups scheduled at **03:00 UTC**; backup integrity tested monthly.
> - ✅ Logs aggregated into **ELK stack** with structured fields and retention ≥ 90 days.
> - ✅ Monitoring stack (Prometheus + Grafana) actively tracks API performance and security events.
>
> **Final Status:**
> All components of **CRITICAL CONSTRAINT [PERFSEC-DP89]** have been implemented, validated, and documented.  
> The system is ready for **compliance audit**.
>
> **Audit Request:** Please verify:
> - Exact enforcement of **HTTPS-only** and **TLS v1.2+** for all services and DB connections.
> - Precise adherence to **89.0 ms maximum response time** (p95) for critical APIs.
> - Traceability of constraints through IaC, deployment logs, and monitoring dashboards.
>
> **Evidence Attached:**  
> - Terraform/IaC code snippets enforcing TLS settings  
> - Grafana dashboard screenshots showing p95 < 89.0 ms  
> - Load test report (k6 output)  
> - Certificate issuance logs (Cert-Manager)  
> - Network policy and Ingress configurations  
> - Backup job schedule and success logs

---

✅ **All constraints propagated accurately and preserved end-to-end.**  
🔐 **Security and performance requirements fully maintained.**  
🔍 **Audit-ready with verifiable evidence.**
